annotations.text:
The live screener as shipped 2026-08-28, rebuilt element-for-element from its real stylesheet (Annum brand: #FF0055 accent, Manrope + IBM Plex Mono, 14px radii).

Latest: question 3 is multi-select (rental / staying / buying / utility, any combination), rent-or-own is asked only for staying, and the circumstances step gained a not-stably-housed checkbox. Results now group by program type (Housing & rent help / Buying a home / Home repair / Utility bills / Other support) and programs built for a confirmed circumstance rank first with pink 'For veterans'-style tags — cards can stack several. Homeless-serving evidence is read across tenure, crisis rule, and program name, and the same treatment applies to every market with no per-market code. Each section shows its best four behind a Show-more button; collapsed cards never truncate and stretch evenly to their grid row. Tapping a card (or its Details button) opens the program detail dialog — see the Program detail dialog artboard: facts in the left column, a sunken action rail (next steps, contact, buttons) on the right, over a dimmed backdrop.

Also here: tap-to-advance questions, grouped foldable results, editable answer chips, shareable results link, and the housing plan.

Restyle anything here — hand the canvas back and the changes get implemented in the real CSS.
